goal: Make peer-to-peer message handling easier to navigate and review
Break up a monolithic one-thousand-line message processing function into dedicated helpers
agreement: Broad support for breaking up the monolithic handler (stickies-v, theStack, maflcko)
Verified as a pure move-only refactor preserving semantics (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds, l0rinc)
Resolved concern that separate helpers add caller friction compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is a move-only cleanup without protocol behavior changes or hazard fixes
Benefit is internal maintainability for developers working on message processing logic
